description: P3 coupling. The overlord consumer pins the imperative sentence `Delegate `with exact file scope`.` — the verb is what makes the pin discriminating, and the full sentence occurs exactly once in overlord.md, so its deletion is loud. The bare fragment `with exact file scope` appears three times in overlord.md; pinning the fragment alone would let any single occurrence vanish while another occurrence keeps the presence pin green.

source.pattern: Do not expand scope beyond assigned files

consumers.pattern: You implement only within explicitly assigned file scope
